Gain must sit in 34–35 dB, because f3db = GBW/A ≥ 5 MHz needs A ≤ 54. L1 = 0.4 and Lp = 0.7 set this window. M1 W is solved so Id(0.75 V) = I1, and the PMOS is sized at the exact mirror vgs to hold vout near 0.9 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "I1":    (80e-6, 50e-6, 95e-6),   # main branch current
    "L1":    (0.40, 0.25, 0.8),       # input device L (sets gds_n -> gain window)
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),      # initial guess only; vgs is pinned at vin_dc
    "Lp":    (0.7, 0.4, 1.5),         # PMOS load L
    "gmidp": (7.0, 5.0, 11.0),        # PMOS load gm/Id (headroom vs cap)
    "Ib2":   (5e-6, 3e-6, 12e-6),     # PMOS mirror reference branch
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),         # NMOS bias mirror L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vout_t = 0.9
    I1, L1, Lp, gp, Ib2, Lb = p["I1"], p["L1"], p["Lp"], p["gmidp"], p["Ib2"], p["Lb"]

    # --- M1: size so that Id(vgs=vin_dc, vds=0.9) == I1 exactly
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], L1, I1, vds=vout_t)
    W1 = m1.W
    for _ in range(4):
        o = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vin, vout_t)
        W1 = W1 * I1 / max(o["Id"], 1e-12)
    o1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vin, vout_t)
    cdd1 = m1.cdd * W1 / m1.W

    # --- NMOS bias mirror from ibias
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 10, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", 10, Lb, iref, vds=mb1.vgs)

    # --- PMOS diode reference (Mp3) and load (Mp2)
    mp3 = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, Ib2, vds=0.9)
    mp3 = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, Ib2, vds=mp3.vgs)
    vsg = mp3.vgs

    # Mb2 sinks Ib2 at vgs = mb1.vgs, vds = vdd - vsg
    Wb2 = mb1.W * Ib2 / iref
    for _ in range(4):
        o = lut.op("n", Wb2, Lb, mb1.vgs, vdd - vsg)
        Wb2 = Wb2 * Ib2 / max(o["Id"], 1e-12)

    # Mp2 sources I1 at vsg, vsd = vdd - vout_t
    W2 = mp3.W * I1 / Ib2
    for _ in range(4):
        o = lut.op("p", W2, Lp, vsg, vdd - vout_t)
        W2 = W2 * I1 / max(o["Id"], 1e-12)
    o2 = lut.op("p", W2, Lp, vsg, vdd - vout_t)
    mp2ref = lut.size("p", gp, Lp, I1, vds=vdd - vout_t)
    cdd2 = mp2ref.cdd * W2 / mp2ref.W

    def mfing(W, wmax=20.0):
        return max(1, min(200, int(math.ceil(W / wmax))))

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    m_1 = mfing(W1)
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1 / m_1, L1, m=m_1)
    m_2 = mfing(W2)
    n.M("Mp2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W2 / m_2, Lp, m=m_2)
    m_3 = mfing(mp3.W)
    n.M("Mp3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", mp3.W / m_3, Lp, m=m_3)
    m_b1 = mfing(mb1.W)
    n.M("Mb1", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", mb1.W / m_b1, Lb, m=m_b1)
    m_b2 = mfing(Wb2)
    n.M("Mb2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wb2 / m_b2, Lb, m=m_b2)

    # --- predictions
    gm1 = o1["gm"]
    gds = o1["gds"] + o2["gds"]
    A = gm1 / gds
    cgd1 = m1.cgd * W1 / m1.W
    ctot = cl + cdd1 + cdd2 + cgd1
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    f3db = gds / (2 * PI * ctot)
    power = vdd * (iref + Ib2 + I1)
    vdsat_n = o1["vdsat"]
    vdsat_p = o2["vdsat"]
    swing = (vdd - vdsat_p - 0.05) - (vdsat_n + 0.05)
    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "gbw": gbw,
        "f3db": f3db,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout_t,
        "swing": swing,
    }
